evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of annealing temperature on tensile properties
evidence.quote: we conclude that the deterioration in the ductility with decreasing annealing temperature was due to the precipitation of the η-phase during annealing.

evidence.section: 4.3 Grain size dependence of plastic deformation behavior
evidence.quote: the strain-induced γ-to-ε martensitic transformation was suppressed by performing LTHT, resulting in the improvement of ductility.
